column1: # note: The Form 40 line 20 worksheet: taxable income less $4,811 (single or married filing separately) or $9,622 (married filing jointly, head of household, qualifying surviving spouse), times 5.3%, not below zero. Written as a 0% bracket up to that amount and 5.3% above it. Idaho prints no tax table for 2025.
# note: The instructions say to round amounts to the nearest whole dollar (page 8, Rounding); the test rounds line 20 so.
# note: Hand-transcribed from the PDF and checked against its text twice.
